description:
List the API keys of your account, newest first. The secret of a key is never shown again.
Use for: finding the id of a key to revoke, and seeing which keys are active and when they were last used.
Not for: making a new key (create_api_key); turning a key off (revoke_api_key).
Needs: an API key. Hosted sign-in cannot call this yet.
Replies omit a field's sole empty value. If null is allowed, only null is omitted; false, [] and a present group stay. A present empty group is {}. Field descriptions explain unavailable values.
Example: list_api_keys({})
Errors: only the common ones; each error carries `fix`: what to do next.
name: list_api_keys

data.description: Every key of this account, revoked ones too, newest first.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 time with an offset, for example 2026-11-20T09:00:00-08:00.

id.description: Use it as keyId in revoke_api_key.

isActive.description: Left out when the key is revoked.

lastUsedAt.description: Updated at most once an hour. Left out when the key was never used.

prefix.description: The first 12 characters of the key, to tell keys apart.

revokedAt.description: Left out while the key is active.

title: List your API keys
